description: Defines the ShareProductDividendPayOutDetails class, representing dividend payout details for share products, including fields for product ID, amount, dividend period dates, status, and associated account dividend details.

classes.name: ShareProductDividendPayOutDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing dividend payout details for a share product, including payout amount, period, status, and associated account dividend details.

methods.name: ShareProductDividendPayOutDetails(Long, BigDecimal, LocalDate, LocalDate)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize dividend payout details with product ID, amount, and dividend period dates.

methods.name: getDividendPeriodEndDateAsLocalDate()
methods.description: Returns the end date of the dividend period.

methods.name: getAccountDividendDetails()
methods.description: Returns the list of associated share account dividend details.

methods.name: approveDividendPayout()
methods.description: Sets the payout status to approved.

methods.name: getStatus()
methods.description: Returns the current payout status as a ShareProductDividendStatusType.
